name: weret
description: WERET monorepo: Flutter mobile + Express backend + admin web.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,flutter -c blue,green "npm run backend" "npm run mobile"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm run test:smoke --prefix backend
scripts.brand:generate: python scripts/generate-weret-brand-assets.py && cd apps/mobile-flutter && dart run flutter_launcher_icons && dart run flutter_native_splash:create
